en.name: Healpen
en.desc: A journaling app based on expressive writing. Entries are encrypted on the phone before they sync. Version 1.12.0 went to Google Play internal testing on 26 October 2026.
en.long:
- Works offline and syncs in the background
- Entries are encrypted on the device with AES-GCM
- Sentiment scoring on each entry
- Onboarding animations in Rive
- Releases through GitHub Actions

en.name: Headspare
en.desc: Headspare ranks your AI usage limits by what runs out first and gives each a pace verdict. Coming soon to Mac, iPhone and Android. Join the waitlist.
en.long: The site went up on 26 October 2026. The waitlist is double opt-in: nothing is added until you tap the link in the email. Nothing is available to download yet. The social handle is @headspareapp. The name may still change.

en.name: Peakward
en.desc: A running app that builds training plans from HealthKit data, with a small self-hosted backend.
en.long: The plan adapts after every run.

en.name: famon
en.desc: An open-source Dart CLI that streams Firebase Analytics events from Android and iOS device logs. On pub.dev.
en.long:
- Shows Firebase Analytics events as they happen
- Android and iOS, simulators and real devices
- Filters and session stats
- Keeps events locally with Isar
- Released through CI

en.name: Efimeries
en.desc: A web app for doctors in Greek public hospitals. It builds fair on-call schedules with a constraint solver.
en.long:
- Custom constraint solver for the schedule
- Balances weekends, holidays, and days off
- Drag and drop with undo and redo
- No server: PDF and Excel export and sharing by URL happen in the browser
- Playwright, Vitest, and axe-core in CI

en.name: Budget Coach
en.desc: A budgeting app with a daily check-in and a weekly review. iOS, TestFlight beta.
en.long: For people who want a grip on their money without a spreadsheet.

en.name: LocalMind
en.desc: An iOS app that runs a language model on the phone. Nothing leaves the device. TestFlight beta.
